LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderWorkCrew.label: Work Crew
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderWorkCrew.description: Give a work order to up to three nearby allies. Accepted orders grant 10/15/20% work speed for 10 seconds while they continue their job. Costs 20% stamina. Cooldown 45 seconds.
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderRally.label: Rally Point
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderRally.description: Set a point within 12 cells. Up to 2/3/4 accepting allies inside its three-cell radius receive 15 protection for eight seconds. Costs 25% stamina. Cooldown 40 seconds.
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderOperationEvac.label: Everyone Home: evacuation
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderOperationEvac.descrip: After five seconds of preparation, up to four accepting allies gain 20% speed and 25 protection for 20 seconds. The commander must maintain position and sight. Costs 60% stamina. Both operation modes share a two-day cooldown.
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderOperationAid.label: Everyone Home: emergency work
LanguageData.TM_Bridge_CommanderOperationAid.descript: After five seconds of preparation, boost up to four accepting rescue, tending or repair workers for 20 seconds. All materials are consumed normally. Both modes impose command fatigue and share a two-day cooldown.
